description: T2 Holdings operational rules — scheduling, billing, vendor management, compliance.
rules: Weekly Costco catalog refresh runs Sunday 03:00 via Windows Task Scheduler (NorthstarCostcoCatalogRefresh).
Zero automatic retries after provider block/rate-limit (401/403/429); next scheduled run is the natural retry.
All live provider calls require explicit human approval token (one-run, finite caps).
Costco Business Center invoices are the sole source of purchase-authorized COGS (cost_status=invoice_confirmed).
Discovery/catalog costs are estimated only; never authorize purchase without invoice confirmation + Amazon listing checks.
